```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
```

```{r}
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

births_tibble <- read_excel("data/us_births_1994_2014.xlsx") |>
  mutate(day_of_week = factor(day_of_week,
                              levels = c("Sun", "Mon", "Tues", "Wed", "Thurs", "Fri", "Sat"),
                              ordered = TRUE))

summary(births_tibble[c("births", "year")])

births_tibble |>
  group_by(month, date_of_month) |>
  summarize(avg_births = mean(births), .groups = "drop") |>
  ggplot(aes(x = date_of_month, y = factor(month, levels = 12:1), fill = avg_births)) +
  geom_tile()

christmas_data <- births_tibble |>
  filter(month == 12, date_of_month %in% c(20:25, 27:30)) |>
  group_by(year) |>
  summarize(
    dec25_births = sum(births[date_of_month == 25]),
    baseline_avg = mean(births[date_of_month %in% c(20:24, 27:30)]),
    pct_of_baseline = dec25_births / baseline_avg * 100,
    dec25_weekday = day_of_week[date_of_month == 25]
  )

summary(christmas_data)

ggplot(christmas_data, aes(x = year, y = pct_of_baseline, color = dec25_weekday)) +
  geom_line(color = "black") +
  geom_point()

births_model <- lm(births ~ factor(year) + factor(month) + day_of_week,
                   data = births_tibble)

summary(births_model)$r.squared

births_adjusted <- births_tibble |>
  mutate(pct_resid = residuals(births_model) / mean(births) * 100)

calendar_resid <- births_adjusted |>
  filter(!(month == 2 & date_of_month == 29)) |>
  group_by(month, date_of_month) |>
  summarize(mean_pct_resid = mean(pct_resid), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(date = as.Date(paste(2001, month, date_of_month, sep = "-")))

ggplot(calendar_resid, aes(x = date, y = mean_pct_resid)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50") +
  annotate("text", x = as.Date("2001-12-25"), y = min(calendar_resid$mean_pct_resid[calendar_resid$month == 12 & calendar_resid$date_of_month == 25]),
           label = "Christmas", vjust = -0.5, size = 3) +
  annotate("text", x = as.Date("2001-01-01"), y = min(calendar_resid$mean_pct_resid[calendar_resid$month == 1 & calendar_resid$date_of_month == 1]),
           label = "New Year's Day", vjust = -0.5, size = 3) +
  annotate("text", x = as.Date("2001-07-04"), y = min(calendar_resid$mean_pct_resid[calendar_resid$month == 7 & calendar_resid$date_of_month == 4]),
           label = "July 4th", vjust = -0.5, size = 3) +
  annotate("text", x = as.Date("2001-11-22"), y = min(calendar_resid$mean_pct_resid[calendar_resid$month == 11 & calendar_resid$date_of_month == 22]),
           label = "Thanksgiving", vjust = -0.5, size = 3)
```
